{{Top|leg}}
'''Taskforce Shen''' was a [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|SpecForce]] unit in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The unit was composed of two [[Infiltrator/Legends|Infiltrator]] [[Platoon/Legends|platoons]], a [[Pathfinders/Legends|Pathfinder]] platoon, and two technical squads.

Taskforce Shen was primarily active in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] region.

Members of Taskforce Shen included the commanding officer [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Mart Stevez]], First [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Vu Nin]], and Lieutenant [[Mishowan Shigormallan]].
